items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:
items.claim: The text says the LORD told Moses to tell the priests, the sons of Aaron, that none of them may become ritually defiled for a dead person among his people.
items.action: forbid ritual defilement for the dead
items.object: the priests, the sons of Aaron
items.mechanism: a command passed on from the LORD through Moses to the priests

items.quote: But for his kin, that is near unto him, that is, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother.
items.claim: The text makes an exception to the ban: a priest may become defiled for close family, meaning his mother, father, son, daughter and brother.
items.object: a priest's close family (mother, father, son, daughter, brother)
items.mechanism: an exception to the ban in verse 21:1, limited to the relatives it names
